cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Kotak White card offering flexible rewards, milestone benefits, and lifestyle perks tailored for aspirational users.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Lost card liability cover worth ₹2.5 lakh against unauthorized transactions, applicable from 7 days prior to the time of reporting the loss of the card to the bank.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Kotak Mahindra Bank Customer Care at 1860 266 2666 or email care@zurichkotak.com within 30 days of the incident. Ensure to submit all required documents within 60 days of reporting the claim.
